premise: Beaver's pond needs a boat; Pinecone closes her scales snug and floats, Ladybug is captain, Beaver's gnawed stick pushes them off, and bubbles rise all around.
inspiration: The voyage of Lear's Owl and the Pussy-cat, turned small and safe: a pond instead of the sea, and home again by teatime.
lesson: Adventures are best with friends to share them.

en-US.title: The Pinecone Boat
en-US.text: {beaver:enter} Beaver's pond was smooth and shiny. [curious] What it needs, said Beaver {beaver:pulse}, is a boat. {pinecone:enter} Pinecone came rolling down to the water's edge. {pinecone:face happy} I can be a boat! {pinecone:live} She opened her scales wide, like a flower… then closed them up snug and smiled. No water can get in now! {sfx:plop} Plop! In she went, {pinecone:float loop 0.3} bobbing. [excited] But who will be the captain? {ladybug:enter} Ladybug came walking up. {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} Me! {beaver:live} Beaver gnawed his stick, crunch, crunch, till the chips flew, held it up and patted it proudly: a pole to push with! Off they sailed, past the reeds. Then Beaver dipped his nose in and blew. {canvas:bubbles 0.7 14s} {sfx:bubbles} Blub, blub, blub! {pinecone:face surprised} {ladybug:face surprised} Bubbles rose all around the boat. {all:face happy} [laughs] Pop, pop, pop! [happily] Back on shore, {ladybug:live} Captain Ladybug lifted her red wing cases, fluttered her thin wings, folded them away… and took a very proper bow. {beaver:hearts} {pinecone:hearts}

es-ES.title: El barco de piña
es-ES.text: La charca de {beaver:enter} Castor estaba lisa y brillante. [curious] Le falta un barco, dijo Castor {beaver:pulse}. {pinecone:enter} Piña llegó rodando hasta la orilla. {pinecone:face happy} ¡Yo puedo ser un barco! {pinecone:live} Abrió sus escamas de par en par, como una flor… luego las cerró bien apretadas y sonrió. ¡Así no entra el agua! {sfx:plop} ¡Plof! Al agua que fue, {pinecone:float loop 0.3} meciéndose. [excited] Pero ¿quién será la capitana? {ladybug:enter} Mariquita llegó andando. {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} ¡Yo! {beaver:live} Castor royó su palo, cric, crac, hasta que volaron las virutas, lo levantó y le dio unas palmaditas: ¡una pértiga para empujar! Y allá que navegaron, entre los juncos. Entonces Castor metió el hocico y sopló. {canvas:bubbles 0.7 14s} {sfx:bubbles} ¡Blub, blub, blub! {pinecone:face surprised} {ladybug:face surprised} Las burbujas subían alrededor del barco. {all:face happy} [laughs] ¡Pop, pop, pop! [happily] De vuelta en la orilla, {ladybug:live} la capitana Mariquita levantó sus alas rojas, agitó sus alitas finas, las guardó… e hizo una reverencia muy elegante. {beaver:hearts} {pinecone:hearts}

plop.prompt: a small pinecone dropping into calm pond water, a soft plop

bubbles.prompt: gentle underwater bubbles rising and popping at a pond surface
